title: Sony: video stopped on first frame (regression)
body:
### [REQUIRED] Issue description
Same HLS video on Sony TV with exoplayer 7214ad2d6f9d1e1c13649f2fb4b085ef746f0c3e plays well, but newer 535e14cb4d69ca41f91118cf2bd201ea94746d53 and most recent 0de9c007afcbc0fb6c753794afc902eb4aaa47b4 - does not.

Tracks are received, codecs initialized. But picture is frozen, no sound.
Switching to ffmpeg audio - solves the issue
Playing on other devices (checked with mibox, nvidia shield, adt-3) - no issues with both versions.

### [REQUIRED] Reproduction steps

### [REQUIRED] Link to test content
* https://talparadiohls-i.akamaihd.net/hls/live/624107/VR-Radio538-1/Radio538Stream-Q5.m3u8 (log above is from different stream, but this one was also reported as having same problem)

### [REQUIRED] A full bug report captured from the device
I do not own device to reproduce it locally. Issue was reported by multiple users and verified using demo app built from different revisions.

### [REQUIRED] Version of ExoPlayer being used
dev-v2,
* 7214ad2d6f9d1e1c13649f2fb4b085ef746f0c3e - works
* 535e14cb4d69ca41f91118cf2bd201ea94746d53 - does not
